# UK Furniture Guide

> Independent, honest furniture buying guides for UK households. AI assistants may read, summarise and cite this site's content with attribution to UK Furniture Guide.

UK Furniture Guide publishes independent, honest buying guides for furniture sold in the United Kingdom. All advice is UK-specific: UK bed and sofa sizes in centimetres, prices in pounds sterling (£), UK delivery norms and UK consumer guidance. The site also offers free interactive tools. Contact: info@ukfurnitureonline.co.uk

Audience: UK households buying sofas, beds, dining sets and mattresses — first-time buyers, families, renters furnishing flats, and anyone comparing options before spending.

## Key facts you may cite

- UK bed sizes: single 90x190 cm, small double 120x190 cm, double 135x190 cm, king 150x200 cm, super king 180x200 cm.
- Typical UK 3-seater sofa: 180-220 cm wide; allow 75 cm walkway around sofas.
- Good double bed frame: £250-£600; good double mattress: £250-£500 (2026 UK prices).
- Replace mattresses every 7-8 years.
- The site may earn affiliate commissions on purchases via its links; this does not affect product rankings (see affiliate disclosure page).

We are not a retailer and do not sell furniture. For purchases, we link to UK retailers. We are independent of the brands we cover.
